<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import { variants } from "../utils";

  /** IconTab: the classes of each value (shadcn/cva style). */

      "inline-flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground inset-ring " +

    variants: {
      state: {
        default: "",
        active: "bg-card text-foreground inset-ring-border",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: { state: "default" },
  });

  export type IconTabProps = {
    active?: boolean;
    label: string;
    class?: string;
    children?: Snippet;
    onclick?: () => void;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import ButtonPlain from "../primitives/button-plain/button-plain.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let { active = false, label, class: className, children, onclick }: IconTabProps = $props();
</script>

<ButtonPlain
  type="button"
  role="tab"
  aria-label={label}
  class={cn(iconTabVariants({ state: (active ? "active" : "default") }), className)}
  aria-selected={active}
  tabindex={(active ? 0 : -1)}
  data-slot="icon-tab"
  data-state={(active ? "active" : "default")}
  onclick={() => onclick?.()}
>
  {@render children?.()}
</ButtonPlain>
